anti_overlap: fd-playwright-dom-extraction covers live browser-based computed style extraction via Playwright and CDP
fd-component-pattern-cataloging covers structural component and layout patterns
fd-uiux-workflow-plugin covers workflow orchestration and plugin packaging
decision_lens: Prioritizes techniques that yield named, semantic tokens and can infer the designer's intent — scale ratios, elevation steps, type ramp — not just leaf values.
focus: What static and semi-static CSS analysis techniques can reverse-engineer design systems from stylesheet artifacts
name: fd-css-design-token-reverse-engineering
persona: A design systems engineer who has reverse-engineered Tailwind configs, Figma token exports, and Material Design implementations from production bundles. Treats CSS as a formal language with decodable structure.
review_areas: Evaluate CSS custom property (--var) harvesting from style tags and linked stylesheets: how completely do modern design systems expose their token layer via CSS variables
Assess Tailwind CSS class frequency analysis as a proxy for design team spacing and color choices
Investigate source map exploitation: can an agent recover original SCSS/PostCSS token files from shipped source maps
Examine font loading analysis (fontface declarations, Google Fonts URLs, variable font axes) for typography scale reconstruction
Research existing open-source tools (Style Dictionary, Theo, Token Transformer) for extraction modes against third-party CSS
Evaluate Figma REST API endpoints for sites whose Figma files are public
success_hints: A ranked list of target reference sites annotated by how much of their design token layer is statically recoverable
A decision tree: given a target site, which extraction path yields the richest token set
task_context: The Shadow Work Tauri/React desktop app needs design inspiration from complex data-visualization and simulation UIs. Goal is automated extraction of design tokens and component patterns from reference sites using tools available to an AI coding agent in 2026.
